facts.fact: Communication Technologies Minister Sofien Hemissi said his ministry has begun drafting legal and regulatory frameworks for responsible use of AI, protecting data and privacy.
facts.system: legal and regulatory frameworks for responsible AI use

TUN.note: Digital administration is named only as a strategy priority; no government body is stated to pilot or use an AI system.

facts.fact: Minister Hemissi said his ministry, with the Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries ministry, has begun setting up a new version of the National Water Observatory giving real-time monitoring and short and medium-term forecasts, under the strategy's predictive-modelling priority for agriculture.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries with the Communication Technologies ministry

TUN.note: Only national AI centres of excellence are named as a strategy aim; no model, dataset or computing facility with a builder or site is stated.
Startup support is named only as one line of the AI strategy's research axis; no startup act, strategy or fund is stated.
No hub, incubator or park is named.
